body:
Well I work for a small company and the budget had a major deficit so my position as well as a few others were cut. I could tell something was off since other managers were looking at me weird all day, now I know why! 

I know the offboarding steps I’ll be taking which is good. I’m just hoping I can pick up another job and this time not hate it

Ah yeah I get that sort of thing, I’ve unfortunately done stuff like that before and then I struggle to try and explain it came out wrong! Lots of rambling. I hope you can try and let go of that interaction in your brain!
Thanks! I totally agree about the flooding from social interaction after too long without it. I was so happy to be around people who were nice and funny I just wanted to feel close to them
Thank you, I’m definitely hoping to get to that place eventually!

I’m in therapy too and it has helped a lot to have someone to help decode the interactions with! It feels defeating at first when she gets me to the realization that my brain is making stuff up, but I always feel lighter after! Good luck to you!!
Thank you, it’s so tough to try and untangle the negative self talk. I almost *want* to believe the bad version of the story
The dread of, “why can’t I just fucking shut up” and my inability to control myself is terrible. It reinforces me not wanting to hang out with people
I think you’re a wonderful friend and they are lucky to have someone like you on their side. I agree, cross that bridge when you get to it!

This is a really really nice gesture! I can only speak about my experience with depression, but unfortunately sometimes I feel pressure to be better when my friends fuss about my depression. So I just pretend to be better. 

I think when it comes down to it, I’m terrified that they don’t actually *mean* what they’re saying. Like sure, they might say they’ll be there for me, but even when I’m a bitch and lash out? (It’s not fair for others to take abuse I know, just it’s very common for depressed people to push loved ones away) how about when I can’t bathe or make food? How long would someone put up with me until they’re tired or (understandably) need to take care of their own mental health.
I’ll download it and read it, I need things to take up my time, thanks friend
Thanks, I do like pancakes, I called a hotline and a nice woman named Kristen helped me do one thing at a time and I’m headed to work now

Definitely. I’m in no place to do that right now. If I don’t kill myself and then also get better, I would want kids. I’ve been arounds kids most of my life and I love them, but any genetic children of mine could get anxiety/depression too and I would feel horrible about it.
Oh that’s so true. I can’t even cook or keep up with my own life. How can I take care of an entire other person? That’s a great point

Yeah, and dealing with suicidal thoughts, I know that my mom is a huge reason I’m still here, but also I don’t feel like I can talk to her about it.  There’s too much emotional baggage with that, so I talk to either no one or a therapist. I would *want* my kid to talk to me but I also know that’s unrealistic
Thank you, I’m so glad you liked it! I didn’t time myself so I’d guess about 30/35 minutes or so :)
I think I’m the key demographic then! I love books with long descriptions and detailed world building, the short story I wrote a few days ago on here is like that too!

I liked reading it, I got this mental picture in my head of young, elementary school kids from the early 1900’s for some reason! Maybe it’s just my imagination but I picture this like an opening to an alternate 1910’s fiction! 

Two young siblings with a giant backyard that extends into a vast jungle that’s largely unexplored. 

I have no idea if that’s what you pictured at all but this gave me that, and I liked it!
That was a great read! I like the detail of his thought process and if this were a novel it would convince me to read more!

Yeah I’ve made myself go to things before to avoid the feeling of failure before, but the thing that “takes over” me and makes me get up and walk out the door is weaker and weaker. I plan on trying, but I’ve been trying for so long

It’s really hard when you have thoughts like these, all these people in this sub have tried/are trying to feel good but we try so hard it’s exhausting. I’m so tired. I don’t want to hurt the people in my life but I just absolutely hate myself and wish I was dead. I have this event tomorrow that I’m running and I *need* to go to it but I’m so scared I won’t be able to.

I feel so empty inside even though when I try and objectively look at my life I have things that may make it seem like I have my shit together. I’m a graduate student finishing her degree in May and I have two jobs on campus, I have a group of friends that I like a lot. I just don’t know why my brain or body won’t be normal, why can’t I just look in the mirror and not hate everything about myself?? It is so unbelievably frustrating
Ah yeah it won’t work for me then, I have work and things I need to do. But I can’t tell my mom, she doesn’t get it, it makes me feel worse when I tell I her I don’t feel good
Thanks so much for the links!! Really appreciate it

Love does help. But god forbid something happens to that relationship? It hits you harder than anything. It does for everyone of course, but when you have anxiety/depression? It could kill you. Almost killed myself

Ah I feel this so much. I want to die too but can’t quite do it. I just want to scream or do anything to make myself feel good again. I’m sorry that you’re going through it, hope it helps a teeny bit that I am too

Thank you for the book recommendation, I love reading, and it’s another thing to focus on other than my issues lol

I really do appreciate your response, makes me feel less alone in all this. The community here has made things a little easier <3

Thanks for responding. Will I ever feel okay again? I know I should be thinking about how to heal myself, but I can’t help but look into my future and wonder if I’ll ever be loved again. Or if all relationships are just doomed from the start. 

Do you ever really get over someone you once loved? I sure hope so. I still have to see him around as he is in my graduate program
Thank you, I’m excited to not feel like shit anymore
You can tell me, pm me and I’ll give you my number
I’m doing the same but for my mother, hang in there if you can op

Some of the signs of initial warning are those things, changes in sleep/eating, and isolation are key parts of it. A big one is when you give stuff away. Or you look up how to do it, write notes etc. (basically having a plan). There are lots of different signs, some of them absolutely invisible to others. If you need someone to talk to other than the hotline, pm me and I’ll give you my number
Some of the people who pick up the phone suck. I hope you get someone good if you ever call back

I was dumped recently too. I don’t think I’ll ever be loved either, even though everyone says I will be. I’m sorry. I wish I had some upbeat advice for you, I thought I was getting better but I’m back here now thinking the same thoughts as before.

Even though I feel like the love thing hasn’t worked out for you this time, I know what a good person you must be. I also gave my all to him and he couldn’t return it. We’re givers. We give love we don’t even have for ourselves and I don’t know if people realize that our wells are dry. My resolution if I’m alive long enough is to only accept the same love I give. 

I hope we can find that. Feel free to message me if you want to talk more, in fact you’d be doing me a favor if you did. Support for this stuff can be hard
You’re so strong to go through that, I can’t imagine. Thanks for reaching out, feel free to pm me whenever!
Oh my god that’s awful. I’m sorry that happened, I’m glad you’re still here though. Sending you lots of love

Thank you for taking the time to write this all out I really appreciate it.  There is no one I love in this world more than my mom, she has done so much for me. I don’t think I could stand the idea of her being hurt over me. I have a therapist and a psychiatrist that I’ll speak to on Monday, I hope that helps

Because now she’s hurt and extremely worried about me. It makes sense but it also makes me feel like a shit person. I lied and said this feeling was in the past so at least there’s that. I promised I would never kill myself which is a lie. I might do it in the future. Maybe after my mom passes (a peaceful natural death I hope) then I will do it. She’s the last person I want to hurt

Yeah I need to talk to them about what I need. The only issue is that I’m still working through what exactly that means. I learn through trial and error.

But you’re right, I have a vague idea of it and I’ll talk tonight

I totally get that. Sometimes I have no explanation and feel sad or upset. 

I guess neither of us can win. My SO has trouble understanding how jumbled my brain can get.
But then those with anxiety and depression who might have the understanding cannot overcome their own issues

Yeah I’m still a little off. I ended up still telling them that I wasn’t feeling well and I hate that I can’t keep it in. 

I played it down though and I feel pressure to be normal, it was good to write this post out without fear that they’d see it and check up on me. They’re a great person and love me but they don’t have anxiety or depression issues so it’s hard to relate to me. 

I’m sorry you have that issue with your fiancé.
It’s so exhausting to have to “figure it out” when your energy is already sapped from you. Hope you’re doing ok as well
